summary: A very popular 65 Slayer task. A facemask or Slayer helmet must be worn or dust devils always hit 16 and drain your stats; with it they attack with ranged-based melee, so Protect from Melee or high ranged defence protects you. Most players burst or barrage (or chin) them in the multicombat south-east section of the Catacombs of Kourend, which is the easiest place to reach and has the catacombs drop table; the Smoke Dungeon has a quieter multi task-only area, and the Wilderness Slayer Cave is multi and cannonable but sits in level 25-28 Wilderness.
styleNotes: Low Defence, 35% elemental weakness to air spells, attacks are ranged-based melee; not immune to cannon or thralls.
usefulItems: Bracelet of slaughter or expeditious bracelet
Rune pouch with Ancient Magicks runes

Regular dwarves are level 7-20 and not aggressive, so any combat style works; the task page says they lack valuable drops and give only 10-61 Slayer XP, and advises lower-level players to stick to the lower-levelled dwarves. styleNotes: No elemental weakness listed for regular dwarves; stab (level 10) or crush (level 20) attackers with a max hit of 2-3; not aggressive; not immune to cannon or thralls.

summary: Assigned at 70 combat after Regicide by Vannaka, Chaeldar, Nieve and Duradel. summary: A 66 Slayer task in the Wyvern Cave on Fossil Island, requiring Bone Voyage and Elemental Workshop to be assigned. The wyverns use melee and an icy breath that must be reduced with an elemental, mind, dragonfire or ancient wyvern shield (antifire and the anti-dragon shield do nothing); only the ancient wyvern shield stops the freeze. Tank them with high ranged defence and Protect from Melee, prioritising Spitting Wyverns and Long-tailed Wyverns (fight the latter in melee range) and avoiding Taloned and Ancient Wyverns, which use a typeless ranged attack from any distance. The task is unprofitable and many players buy the Stop the Wyvern unlock to block it.

summary: A beginner task from Turael, Spria and Mazchna at 13 combat. Ghosts are undead, so Crumble Undead and the salve amulet work well, and they drop nothing in most places. Level 19-29 ghosts are scattered across many areas; the Catacombs of Kourend has 17 in a multicombat area and the Sepulchre of Death at the bottom of the Stronghold of Security has 31 level 76-77 ghosts for the most XP per kill. Tortured souls near the Ectofuntus are the task page's pick for mid-levels with Morytania access. Spectres, ghasts, banshees and shades do not count.
styleNotes: Undead and spectral attributes (salve amulet and Crumble Undead effective); 50% elemental weakness to air spells; aggressive; not immune to cannon or thralls.
